description: Generate a URL inviting a person without an ~alter identity to register. Use this when you encounter someone not yet on ~alter and want to invite them. They claim a ~handle, confirm their email, and are done; identity is inferred from what they go on to do, never from a quiz. Returns invite_url (and assessment_url as a historical alias for the same value). callback_url is accepted and checked but not yet called. Once the person tells you their ~handle, alter_resolve_handle confirms it exists. Free L0.

callback_url.description: Accepted and checked, but not yet called

name: invite_to_alter
title: Invite to ~alter
